judgments.rationale: The proposed summary claims that the employer must permit the employee to use the compensatory time 'immediately after the request, even if the use of the compensatory time unduly disrupts the operations of the public agency.' This directly contradicts the source text, which specifies that the employee shall be permitted to use the time 'within a reasonable period after making the request if the use of the compensatory time does not unduly disrupt the operations of the public agency.'

The draft claim left the action and action_quote fields blank. The proposed change accurately populates the action ('permit use of compensatory time') with the exact supporting text from F003 ('shall be permitted by the employee’s employer to use such time'), faithfully capturing the employer's requirement under the statutory conditions.

source_spans.quote:
(5) An employee of a public agency which is a State, political subdivision of a State, or an interstate governmental agency—

(A) who has accrued compensatory time off authorized to be provided under paragraph (1), and

(B) who has requested the use of such compensatory time,


shall be permitted by the employee’s employer to use such time within a reasonable period after making the request if the use of the compensatory time does not unduly disrupt the operations of the public agency.
